plans.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one high-fidelity Chinese university teacher analytics web app concept screenshot. Brand exactly "未然 EDU". The user wants varied beautiful admin dashboard styles, based on real design research of Tremor, shadcn/ui, Dribbble Edutrack and educational BI dashboards. Draw original UI, not replicas of those products. Generate ONE single front-on desktop interface, landscape 16:10, full image is the interface, no browser chrome, no perspective, no hardware, no external annotation. Very sharp professional Simplified Chinese typography with readable text, sophisticated spacing, precise implementable charts. Same product page for all concepts: "学情洞察". Navigation exactly "学情洞察" "画像探索" "测评数据". Batch "程序设计 · 第一次测评". Persistent small badge "演示数据". Demo metrics "参与学生 105" "评价记录 525" "能力维度 5". Five dimensions "算法与数据结构", "代码实现能力", "问题建模能力", "效率意识", "解题策略". Demo rating scale is 1–5 only, chart axis up to 5, averages respectively 2.8, 3.5, 3.2, 3.6, 4.1. Avoid invented attendance, trends, rankings, risk scores, grade pass rates or unsupported claims. Key insight wording "策略表现较好，算法基础仍需关注"; exact condition chips "解题策略 ≥ 4" and "算法与数据结构 < 3"; exact count "21 / 105 人 · 20%". Small status "统计已核验". Distinct explanation text "能力差异的原因仍需结合题目与答题过程验证" marked "解释待验证". Actions "查看依据" and "分析这组学生". Keep words short and sparse enough to remain readable. Original practical UI for teachers with evidence, not finance, LMS scheduling, school administration or generic AI chat. No glowing tech borders, spaceship decorations, random time curves, 3D art, cartoon people, decorative giant numbers without labels. Blue/white identity. DIRECTION D: minimal precision, informed by Tremor/shadcn analytical restraint. Intentionally NOT the previous generic four-rounded-card dashboard. Off-white #FAFAFB background, white slim 176px sidebar, thin neutral borders, 6px corners, no shadows, restrained royal blue #315CF5 charts, refined dark-gray type with tabular numerals. Compact brand upper left and navigation, simple top utility row. Content width generous with 40px page padding. Header "学情洞察" 28px, small explanatory subtitle, batch select right. Three summary metrics in a SINGLE unboxed horizontal typographic strip separated by hairlines, never separate colored KPI cards. Main middle 70% width analytical panel titled "五维能力表现" with FIVE horizontal dotted-baseline bars, each labeled, precise end values on 1–5 scale; below it slender full-width five stacked score-distribution bars labeled 1分 through 5分, no invented extra metrics. Right 30% tall compact white inspector "重点发现" with key insight, large-but-not-huge 21/105 and conditions, blue text link "查看依据", explanation awaiting validation and blue bottom button. Bottom one full-width clean table "评价线索" with rows "边界处理", "调试方法", "复杂度分析", columns "主题" "原文示例" "证据", anonymous source examples, small row links. Focus on visual silence, tight alignment, clean editorial numbers, logical hierarchy. Entire layout under 10 cards; meaningful whitespace, no marketing headings.
